换个关键词，或点「重置」清除筛选条件。: Try another keyword, or click Reset to clear the filters.
列表页表格上方的筛选：FilterBar 左边放搜索框和下拉筛选，按需显示查询、: The filters above a list page's table: FilterBar holds the search box and select filters on the left, the Search and Reset buttons when wanted, and extra actions on the right; status switching uses SegmentedTabs, with counts. The controls are all controlled: the page computes the result or hands it to the API (useCrudList's handleSearch). There is no date range filter: use two DatePickers when needed (see the Pickers page).
输入的内容和生效的关键词分开存：回车才搜索，点清空按钮立即恢复全部。: What is typed and the applied keyword are kept apart: Enter searches, and the clear button shows everything again at once.
第一项是「全部」，选中时值为空字符串；数字选项也以字符串传回，筛选状态用 str: The first item is "All", whose value is an empty string; numeric options come back as strings too, so keep the filter state a string.
下划线样式做状态筛选，count 显示每个状态的数量；pill 样式做 24 小: The underline style filters by status, with count showing each status' total; the pill style is for small toggles like 24 hours / 7 days.
筛选栏编辑草稿，点查询或回车后生效；状态标签立即生效，数量跟随其他筛选条件；右侧: The bar edits a draft that applies on Search or Enter; the status tabs apply at once and their counts follow the other filters; Export sits on the right, and the empty state offers Reset.
本地数据边输入边筛选，不需要查询按钮；有筛选条件时才显示重置，右侧显示条数。: Local data filters as you type, so no Search button; Reset shows only while a filter is set, and the count sits on the right.
筛选控件，从左往右排，窄屏自动换行: The filter controls, laid out left to right, wrapping on narrow screens
传了才显示「查询」按钮: Shows the Search button when set

靠右的内容，例如导出按钮或条数: Content on the right, e.g. an export button or the count

选项 { label, value }，label 为中文原文: Options { label, value }; label is Chinese source text
「全部」项的文字，替代默认的「全部」+ 名称: Text of the "All" item, instead of the default "All" + name

无障碍名称（中文原文，组件内翻译），默认用 placeholder: Accessible name (Chinese source text, translated inside); defaults to placeholder
